name: Tai'jin
summary: At the Razor Hill barracks, Tai'jin teaches young Darkspear priests the balance of light and shadow. She passes on troll spiritual traditions and rites such as the Hex of Weakness.

sections.title: Priestess of Razor Hill
sections.body: Tai'jin guides young priests from the Razor Hill barracks as they set out across Durotar. Orcs here chiefly follow shamanism or warlock arts. Darkspear trolls bring their communion with spirits and loas to the Horde. Tai'jin teaches the first principles of priesthood and the balance of light and shadow, rooted in troll heritage.

faq.answer: Tai'jin can be found on the ground floor of the Razor Hill Barracks in central Durotar, beside the other class trainers.
Tai'jin teaches new priests spells, ranks, and abilities as they gain experience. Her lessons include early instruction for troll initiates.

faq.q: Why is a troll priest stationed in an orc settlement?
aliases: why is taijin in razor hill
faq.answer: Razor Hill trains young Horde adventurers leaving the Valley of Trials and Sen'jin Village. Orcs do not practice priestly arts, so Tai'jin brings Darkspear spiritual traditions to the settlement.

faq.q: What special rites does Tai'jin provide for troll priests?
faq.answer: Tai'jin guides Darkspear priests through introductory spiritual rites, including the Hex of Weakness. The rite channels ancestral curses.

angles.text: As a Horde priest training in Durotar, you learn from Tai'jin before heading to Orgrimmar's grand halls.
As a young Darkspear troll, you can learn distinctive spells from Tai'jin, including the Hex of Weakness.
